item.title: Inter-flake modulation of MXenes for advanced sensing applications
item.description:
Authors: Yizhou Wang, Shuo Li, Dekang Zhu, Ning Chu, Amna Rayan, Noor Albar, Tianchao Guo, Dana Alsulaiman, Husam N. Alshareef

This review highlights the role of inter-flake structure in MXene-based sensing and discusses how spacing, orientation, porosity, and inter-flake chemistry can be controlled to influence its sensing performance.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cs00989a

item.title: Unraveling complexity: advances in metal-catalyzed sequential double hydrofunctionalization of alkynes
item.description:
Authors: Zhaoyang Cheng, Minghua Li, Yufeng Sun, Zhan Lu

This review comprehensively summarizes metal-catalyzed sequential double hydrofunctionalization of alkynes (SDHFA), covering diverse reaction types and selectivity patterns, and highlighting representative mechanisms and synthetic applications.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cs00306k

item.title: Chemical reactions for the ligand-directed modification of native proteins
item.description:
Authors: Anissa Haim, Cassandra J. Henderson, Merve Akdeniz, Timothy Noël, Tom N. Grossmann

This tutorial review introduces the principles of ligand-directed protein modification and compares the chemical strategies that enable selective covalent functionalization of native proteins through ligation, transfer, and catalysis.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cs00702c

item.title: Interfacial reaction-network catalysis: steering complex transformations through physical mixing
item.description:
Authors: Guo Tian, Zining Wang, Chenxi Zhang, Bin Dai, Fei Wei

Physical mixing as a modular strategy for interfacial reaction-network catalysis, steering complex transformations through intermediate relay, catalytic shunting and thermodynamic cascading.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cs00516k

item.title: Porphyrinoids for up- and down-conversion
item.description:
Authors: Henrik Gotfredsen, Jorge Labella, Yifan Bo, Dominik Thiel, Tomás Torres, Dirk M. Guldi, Rik R. Tykwinski

This review summarizes the use of porphyrinoids with molecular down-converters in intramolecular SF (i-SF) and molecular up-converters in intramolecular triplet–triplet energy transfer and triplet–triplet annihilation upconversion.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cs00775a

item.title: Advances in net-1,2-hydrogen atom transfer of oxygen- and nitrogen-centered radicals: mechanisms and applications in synthesis
item.description:
Authors: Haoqin Tang, Yonggang Jiang, Xiaodong Yang, Patrick J. Walsh

This review outlines progress in O- and N-centered radical net-1,2-HAT reactions, covering mechanisms and synthetic applications. The core mechanism, radical translocation from a heteroatom to an α-carbon, enables subsequent coupling or cascades.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cs00029k

item.title: Charge dynamics in covalent organic framework photocatalysts
item.description:
Authors: Supriti Dutta, Pekham Chakrabortty, Bikash Mishra, Pampa Jhariat, Pradip Pachfule

This review discusses exciton behaviour, structural design strategies, spectroscopic probes, and charge-transfer pathways in covalent organic framework photocatalysts to advance efficient solar-to-chemical energy conversion.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cs00824k

item.title: The many faces of organosulfur compounds: photocatalysis, hydrogen-atom transfer, and electron donation in photochemical organic synthesis
item.description:
Authors: Xin-Meng Wu, Li-Jie Wang, Chaozhihui Cheng, Mu-Jia Luo, Ru-Chun Yang, Qiang Xiao

This review highlights the triple role of organosulfur compounds as photocatalysts, HAT reagents, and electron donors in visible-light-driven radical reactions, offering a green and versatile platform for selective bond construction.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cs00734a

item.title: Two-terminal photoelectric synapses for attojoule neuromorphic vision
item.description:
Authors: Chi Zhang, Haoxuan Sun, Muhammad Danish Danial bin Zulkifli, Muhammad Nafie bin Jakariah, Muhammad Fazri bin Jasmin, Aliff Muhaimin bin Kamaruzaman, Konstantinos Davazoglou, Anastasia Soultati, Emmanuel Kymakis, Abd Rashid Bin Mohd Yusoff, Maria Vasilopoulou, Liang Li

Two-terminal photoelectric synapses integrate sensing, memory, and computation for neuromorphic vision. This review connects materials, mechanisms, and system design toward attojoule-scale, scalable, and sustainable neuromorphic hardware.

item.title: Pure-silica zeolites: advances in synthesis, atomic-scale structural determination, and applications
item.description:
Authors: Chao Ma, Yang Hong, Qilong Feng, Ke Long, Shitai Li, Jing Wang, Chenyang Nie, Nana Yan, Xiaona Liu, Yihan Zhu, Peng Guo, Zhongmin Liu

This review covers recent developments in synthesis, atomic-scale structure determination, and applications of pure-silica zeolites, deciphering the relationships among synthesis, structure, and performance.

item.title: α-Lipoic acid: from a mitochondrial cofactor to a versatile platform for dynamic biomaterials and translational biomedicine
item.description:
Authors: Chunyan Cui, Chenxi Zheng, Zhen Liu, Zhen Luo, Ruiqi Sun, Wenguang Liu

This Review highlights α-lipoic acid as a molecular bridge connecting bioactivity and dynamic polymer chemistry, with integrated coverage from redox regulation and polymerization to biomedical applications.

item.title: Toward practical all-solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries: from reaction mechanisms to engineering strategies
item.description:
Authors: Jinghua Wu, Tianyi Liu, Wenjie Wang, Hongli Wan, Xiayin Yao

This review presents a comprehensive framework for practical all-solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries by correlating sulfur reaction mechanisms, interfacial challenges, and engineering strategies toward high-performance and practical applications.
